data.title: DAMAC Villas
data.about:
Welcome to luxury’s new home, at Damac Villas by Paramount Hotels & Resorts, Dubai. Located within Damac Hills, these homes offer an opulent and exclusive lifestyle like no other. Damac Villas are furnished, with light interiors and high ceilings. The large windows overlook the beautiful community. The furnishings offer similar rich overtones that complement the interiors. These villas have the Hollywood flair you cannot find anywhere else, while all that you need is available at your doorstep within the community.

As a resident of Damac villas, you will have access to the private Paramount Clubhouse, as well as children’s playground, swimming pools with private cabanas and more. Located close to the beach and the Mall of Emirates, Damac Hills is just minutes away from Dubai Marina, Madinat Jumeirah, Business Bay and Dubai International Airport. Choose Damac Villas by Paramount to live an unmatched enviable lifestyle within the perfect home you and your family deserves.
